statements.quote: [4.2 Glass breakage] We cover repair or replacement of the windscreen, side windows, rear window and sunroof of the vehicle, including recalibration of cameras and sensors mounted on the windscreen, up to a limit of $1,000 per claim.

statements.statement: The coverage limit for glass damage is $1,000 per claim.

statements.quote: [5.1 Excess] You pay the following excess on each claim: collision claims $300; glass claims $50; theft claims $450. We deduct the excess from the amount we pay.
